parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    request,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
    END AS local_operator_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,book_id}', request->>'book_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,book_id}', request->>'book_id')::uuid
    END AS book_id
  FROM input
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    n.*,
    p.id AS scoped_book_id,
    p.title,
    p.genre_main,
    p.intent_json,
    p.forbid_json,
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.l1a_unit AS locked
      WHERE locked.book_id = p.id
        AND locked.is_locked
        AND locked.is_valid
        AND NOT locked.is_shadow
    ) AS design_editable
  FROM normalized AS n
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project AS p
    ON p.id = n.book_id
   AND p.local_operator_id = n.local_operator_id
), resolved AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    binding.runtime_binding
  FROM scoped AS s
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'node_code', b.node_code,
      'model_config_id', b.model_config_id,
      'model_config_version', b.model_config_version,
      'prompt_config_id', b.prompt_config_id,
      'prompt_version', b.prompt_version,
      'template_type', b.template_type,
      'temperature', b.temperature,
      'prompt_text', b.prompt_text,
      'prompt_status', b.prompt_status,
      'model_name', b.model_name,
      'provider_base_url', b.provider_base_url,
      'api_key_ref', b.api_key_ref,
      'routing_config_jsonb', b.routing_config_jsonb,
      'parameters_jsonb', b.parameters_jsonb
    ) AS runtime_binding
    FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS b
    WHERE b.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
      AND b.node_code = 'FP004-05'
      AND b.prompt_status = 'active'
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY b.model_config_version DESC, b.prompt_version DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS binding ON true
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'request', r.request,
  'book', CASE
    WHEN r.scoped_book_id IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE jsonb_build_object(
      'id', r.scoped_book_id,
      'title', r.title,
      'genre_main', r.genre_main,
      'intent_json', COALESCE(r.intent_json, '{}'::jsonb),
      'forbid_json', COALESCE(r.forbid_json, '{}'::jsonb)
    )
  END,
  'l1a_units', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', l.id,
      'l1a_index', l.l1a_index,
      'l1a_name', l.l1a_name,
      'conflict_background', l.conflict_background,
      'escalation_path', l.escalation_path,
      'stakes', l.stakes,
      'irreversible_consequence', l.irreversible_consequence,
      'plot_emotion_commit', l.plot_emotion_commit,
      'arc_requirement', l.arc_requirement,
      'info_reveal_boundary', l.info_reveal_boundary,
      'role_arc_json', l.role_arc_json,
      'status', l.status,
      'source_type', l.source_type,
      'confirmation_status', l.confirmation_status,
      'is_formal', l.is_formal,
      'is_locked', l.is_locked
    ) ORDER BY l.l1a_index, l.created_at)
    FROM public.l1a_unit AS l
    WHERE l.book_id = r.scoped_book_id
      AND l.is_valid
      AND NOT l.is_shadow
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'characters', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', c.id,
      'char_code', c.char_code,
      'char_name', c.char_name,
      'char_type', c.char_type,
      'five_layers_json', c.five_layers_json,
      'knowledge_boundary_json', c.knowledge_boundary_json,
      'arc_json', c.arc_json
    ) ORDER BY COALESCE(c.char_code, c.char_name), c.id)
    FROM public.character AS c
    WHERE c.book_id = r.scoped_book_id
      AND c.is_active
      AND c.is_formal
      AND c.is_valid
      AND NOT c.is_shadow
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'world_state', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', ws.id,
      'board_type', ws.board_type,
      'atom_type', ws.atom_type,
      'atom_key', ws.atom_key,
      'atom_value_jsonb', ws.atom_value_jsonb,
      'affordance_dims', ws.affordance_dims,
      'setting_layer', ws.setting_layer
    ) ORDER BY ws.setting_layer, ws.board_type, ws.atom_key, ws.id)
    FROM public.world_state AS ws
    WHERE ws.book_id = r.scoped_book_id
      AND ws.is_active
      AND ws.is_formal
      AND ws.is_valid
      AND NOT ws.is_shadow
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'runtime_binding', COALESCE(r.runtime_binding, '{}'::jsonb),
  'config_ready', r.runtime_binding IS NOT NULL,
  'redacted_error', CASE
    WHEN r.scoped_book_id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'SCOPE_REJECTED',
      'message', 'The selected book is unavailable.'
    )
    WHEN r.design_editable IS NOT TRUE THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'DESIGN_LOCKED',
      'message', 'L1A variants are read-only after the L1A plan is locked.'
    )
    WHEN r.runtime_binding IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'CONFIG_CONTRACT_BLOCKED',
      'message', 'An active FP004-05 model and prompt binding is required before variant analysis can start.'
    )
    ELSE NULL
  END
) AS context
FROM resolved AS r;
